title: compat stats: fix system_cpu_usage, precpu_stats, and CPU% docs
body:
- Read `system_cpu_usage` from `/proc/stat` (including idle) instead of `cgroups.SystemCPUUsage()` (active only), matching Docker semantics
- Use CPU values from `GetContainerStats()` instead of a second cgroup read
- Populate `precpu_stats` on `stream=false` requests, matching Docker
- Document `--no-stream CPU%` behavior

Fixes: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/28761
Fixes: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/24730
Fixes: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/25709

comments.body: Cockpit tests failed for commit ff71d2109d36b54f6d195fb635699873b9479a52. @jelly, @mvollmer please check.

Code LGTM, but I do wonder if there's a point to collecting this if all we can give is low-quality data. Docker can provide much more meaningful results thanks to having a daemon, we're stuck in a bad spot as is.
